# Bit crush

Throws away color depth (and optionally resolution), like a frame buffer with too few bits: smooth gradients turn into bands.

<EffectDemo effect="bit-crush" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { bitCrush } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/bit-crush';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(bitCrush({ preset: 'eightBit' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.bits = 3`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type    | Default | Range     | Description                                                    |
| ------------ | ------- | ------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bits`       | number  | `3`     | 1 – 8     | Bits per channel: 1 gives 2 levels, 3 gives 8, 8 is unchanged. |
| `dither`     | boolean | `false` |           | Ordered dithering, which trades bands for a fine pattern.      |
| `downsample` | number  | `1`     | 1 – 16 px | Size of each sample, for a lower resolution as well.           |
| `amount`     | number  | `1`     | 0 – 1     | Mix between the original and the crushed image.                |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                   |
| ---------- | -------------------------- |
| `eightBit` | `bits: 2`, `dither: true`  |
| `harsh`    | `bits: 1`, `downsample: 2` |
| `lofi`     | `bits: 3`, `downsample: 3` |
| `banding`  | `bits: 4`                  |

Apply one with `bitCrush({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Glitch & signal · tracked as story X6.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 3.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 7.2 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/bit-crush`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: Per-channel quantization of display values with optional Bayer dithering.

## Related

- [Dither](./dither) — Reduces each channel to a few levels and hides the banding with a dither pattern: ordered Bayer matrices, void-and-cluster blue noise, or interleaved gradient noise.
- [Palette reduction](./palette) — Repaints the image with only the colors of a classic palette (Game Boy, CGA, EGA, PICO-8, Commodore 64, NES, or four of your own), matched by perceived difference, with optional dithering.
- [Pixelate](./pixelate) — Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.
